The '''mother''' of [[Aven Geth]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was a prominent [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She and [[Aven Geth's father|her husband]] were angered by their son's choice to join the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] as a shield technician rather than join the Imperial Army, and so they used their influence to have their son discharged. Despite his parents' cruelty, Geth continued to serve the Empire, offering his services to any Imperial-aligned crew that would have him.
